status: Experimental, not promoted; v2 data collection in progress

baseline.reference_type: Agent-reviewed identity checkpoints, based on native source images and readable bumpers. Not independent human ground truth or exhaustive frame annotations.
baseline.scope: Primary identity 3970 through a same-match occlusion; 7137 is a same-alliance confusion check. Only listed visible references are scored. No full-match accuracy claim. The ambiguous 98-second frame and unclear 7137 observations after 94 seconds are deliberately unscored.

transfer_baseline.reference_type: Agent-reviewed native readable bumper crops, selected by exact local OCR before local classifier transfer inference; not independent human truth
transfer_baseline.scope: Four readable-bumper transfer observations in QM13. 7137 is learned; 6418 is absent from the identity model and should remain unresolved there. This is a small favorable OCR-selected subset, not full-match accuracy.

limitations: Sparse agent-reviewed observations. No exhaustive ID-switch/accuracy claim. V1 gains on QM3 do not transfer to reviewed QM13 observations; existing OCR baseline is stronger on that separate subset. No default changed.
